not_verifiable: The rendered page was not compared; the page's menu component draws exactly this embedded document. The feed carries only short descriptions, not ingredient lists, so allergen marks were judged against dish names, descriptions and the chain's (V)/(VE) labels.
notes: Feed had drifted since 6 Oct (Caesar Salad and Grilled Bacon Chop changed by sub-gram amounts); script re-run on the fresh page, which also now writes allergens.csv (all 58 rows read, 0 differences against my independent parse of all 7 nutrients and every contains/may-contain mark for 63 feed entries). Held back newly for allergen rows that contradict the dish: Fish & Chips (battered haddock, no gluten marked) and Double Chocolate Brownie + Mini Double Chocolate Brownie (no gluten marked, no gluten-free label); existing holds (Salt & Pepper Calamari kcal vs macros, Trio of Ice Cream) kept. Kept after thought: Aubergine & Sweet Potato Arancini (VE) with no gluten marked (Miller & Carter's arancini is marked the same way, could be a gluten-free coating), Wild Boar Sausage & Mash with no gluten (could be a gluten-free sausage); founder may prefer to hold them back.
